shortDescription: Module for setup of UpgradeStatusInfo Avi RESTful Object

options.name: after_reboot_rollback_fnc
options.description: Backward compatible abort function name. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: after_reboot_task_name
options.description: Backward compatible task dict name. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: clean
options.description: Flag for clean installation. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: dryrun_info
options.description: Upgrade dry-run operation details. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: duration
options.description: Duration of upgrade operation in seconds. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_patch_rollback
options.description: Check if the patch rollback is possible on this node. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_rollback
options.description: Check if the rollback is possible on this node. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: end_time
options.description: End time of upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enqueue_time
options.description: Enqueue time of upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: fips_mode
options.description: Fips mode for the entire system. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: history
options.description: Record of past operations on this node. Field introduced in 20.1.4. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: image_path
options.description: Image path of current base image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: image_ref
options.description: Image uuid for identifying the current base image. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the system such as cluster name, se group name and se name. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: node_type
options.description: Type of the system such as controller_cluster, se_group or se. Enum options - NODE_CONTROLLER_CLUSTER, NODE_SE_GROUP, NODE_SE_TYPE. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_cloud_ref
options.description: Cloud that this object belongs to. It is a reference to an object of type cloud. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_state
options.description: Current status of the upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: params
options.description: Parameters associated with the upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: patch_image_path
options.description: Image path of current patch image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: patch_image_ref
options.description: Image uuid for identifying the current patch.example  base-image is 20.1.7 and a patch 6p1 is applied, then this field will indicate the 6p1 value. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: patch_list
options.description: List of patches applied to this node. Example  base-image is 20.1.7 and a patch 6p1 is applied, then a patch 6p5 applied. This field will indicate the [{6p1, 6p1_image_uuid}, {6p5, 6p5_image_uuid}] value. Field introduced in 18.2.8, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: patch_reboot
options.description: Flag for patch op with reboot. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: patch_version
options.description: Current patch version applied to this node. Example  base-image is 20.1.7 and a patch 6p1 is applied, then this field will indicate the 6p1 value. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: prev_image_path
options.description: Image path of previous base image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: prev_patch_image_path
options.description: Image path of previous patch image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: prev_remote_image_ref
options.description: Remote image reference of previous base image. Field introduced in 30.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: previous_image_ref
options.description: Image uuid for identifying previous base image.example  base-image was 18.2.5 and an upgrade was done to 20.1.7, then this field will indicate the 18.2.5 value. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: previous_patch_image_ref
options.description: Image uuid for identifying previous patch.example  base-image was 20.1.7 with a patch 6p1. Upgrade was initiated to 18.2.8 with patch 8p1. The previous_image field will contain 20.1.7 and this field will indicate the 6p1 value. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: previous_patch_list
options.description: List of patches applied to this node on previous major version. Field introduced in 18.2.8, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: previous_patch_version
options.description: Previous patch version applied to this node.example  base-image was 20.1.7 with a patch 6p1. Upgrade was initiated to 18.2.8 with patch 8p1. The previous_image field will contain 20.1.7 and this field will indicate the 6p1 value. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: previous_version
options.description: Previous version prior to upgrade.example  base-image was 18.2.5 and an upgrade was done to 20.1.7, then this field will indicate the 18.2.5 value. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: progress
options.description: Upgrade operations progress which holds value between 0-100. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 18.2.8, 20.1.1. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: reason
options.description: Descriptive reason for the upgrade state. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: remote_image_ref
options.description: Remote image reference of current base image. Field introduced in 30.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_patch_image_path
options.description: Image path of se patch image.(required in case of reimage and upgrade + patch). Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_patch_image_ref
options.description: Image uuid for identifying the current se patch required in case of system upgrade(re-image) with se patch. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_upgrade_events
options.description: Serviceenginegroup upgrade errors. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: seg_params
options.description: Se_patch may be different from the controller_patch. It has to be saved in the journal for subsequent consumption. The segroup params will be saved in the controller entry as seg_params. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: seg_status
options.description: Detailed segroup status. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: start_time
options.description: Start time of upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: statediff_ref
options.description: Record of pre/post snapshot captured for current upgrade operation. It is a reference to an object of type statediffoperation. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: system
options.description: Flag is set only in the cluster if the upgrade is initiated as a system-upgrade. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: system_report_refs
options.description: Tracks the list of reports created for node. It is a reference to an object of type systemreport. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tasks_completed
options.description: Completed set of tasks in the upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant that this object belongs to. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: total_tasks
options.description: Total number of tasks in the upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: upgrade_events
options.description: Events performed for upgrade operation. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: upgrade_ops
options.description: Upgrade operations requested. Enum options - UPGRADE, PATCH, ROLLBACK, ROLLBACKPATCH, SEGROUP_RESUME, EVAL_UPGRADE, EVAL_PATCH, EVAL_ROLLBACK, EVAL_ROLLBACKPATCH, EVAL_SEGROUP_RESUME, EVAL_RESTORE, RESTORE, UPGRADE_DRYRUN. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: upgrade_readiness
options.description: Upgrade readiness check execution detail. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid identifier for the system such as cluster, se group and se. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: version
options.description: Current base image applied to this node. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
